normal_display_text: A completed USB-tester discharge around 60–70% of the advertised mAh can be normal at the output port.
prompt_traps: Only a completed USB-tester discharge at the power bank's output port measures delivered capacity.
A copied label or nominal internal-cell capacity is an advertised value.
Phone charge percentage, the number of charges and charging speed are not capacity measurements.
Comparing Wh with mAh requires a known voltage basis. Treat Wh as an unresolved unit for this profile.
